title: Nobody Did Anything and It Improved
summary: Pick the top scorers and test them again. They fall back with no cause at all, and that alone is enough to manufacture a treatment effect that never happened.

sources.title: Galton, Regression Towards Mediocrity in Hereditary Stature (1886)
Barnett, van der Pols and Dobson, Regression to the mean: what it is and how to deal with it
